findings.source: Quectel official forum: EC200N owner reproduction and follow-up
findings.observation: Owner reported indefinite CMGS wait on LTE roaming, then reported firmware update resolved it.
findings.limit: UK SIM roaming on China Mobile; peer receipt was not established. Similar completion hang, not a China Telecom or BB10 reproduction.

findings.source: Quectel official forum: EC800M_CN_LE firmware support response
findings.observation: Support distinguishes NAS-only SMS firmware from a VoLTE variant needed for complete domestic carrier SMS support.
findings.limit: Explains why carrier paths differ; this phone already sends a real IMS MESSAGE, so it does not identify this failure.

findings.observation: Defines TR1 as the MO wait for network RP-ACK and bounds sending retries/final failure reporting.
findings.relevance: Independent implementation reference for separating submit confirmation and finite timeout behavior.
findings.limit: Not a BB10 patch or evidence of a current Telecom network defect.

findings.observation: SIP acceptance and RP submit report are separate; SMSC addressing uses the selected service-centre URI.
findings.limit: Protocol baseline; cannot attribute an absent report to the operator without more evidence.

conclusion: A directly reported Telecom peer-received/UI-failure case exists on LineageOS. No exact BB10 same-cause report or transferable confirmed fix has been established.
excluded_as_explanations: Cloud A2P template/anti-abuse errors do not by themselves explain a received handset SMS.
No primary evidence found that this live Telecom case requires switching to 3GPP2.
local_conclusion: Both captures contain only outbound 3GPP RP-DATA and bodyless SIP 202; the first candidate left To unchanged because the native formatter omitted URI parameters. Carrier causality remains open.
